Full release notes: **https://danbyte.net/news/v0-12-0**

### Highlights

- **Windows DHCP & DNS** (#23) — agentless WinRM sync of scopes, exclusions, reservations and leases into IPAM, plus DNS zones with per-zone reconciliation and drift review. Reservations, scopes and zones are fully authorable in Danbyte: creates push to the server (`Add-DhcpServerv4Scope`/`-Reservation`), **local (Danbyte-managed) scopes** work without any server, backed by existing prefixes or new subnets in any **VRF**.
- **DHCP in IPAM** — a dedicated DHCP column on every IP table (solid *leased*, faint *scope pool*, dashed *EXCL* for exclusion carve-outs), pool ghost rows via **Show DHCP pool**, bulk **Add pool** on a prefix, and a Reserve-in-DHCP toggle on the IP form.
- **Virtualization sync** — Proxmox VE and VMware vCenter sources import VMs, disks, virtual switches, port-groups/bridges and VLANs; guest tags (with Proxmox tag colors) and notes ride along. The **network topology** is rebuilt OpenStack-style: networks as full-width colored rails, each VM drawn once with a ribbon-cable leg per attachment, physical host adapters on top, and the same treatment on a VM's own page.
- **VLAN colors** — a VLAN carries its own optional color, and VLANs now render as colored badges (ID · name) everywhere they appear: prefix, IP, interface and VM-interface tables, detail pages, the faceplate, L2VPN terminations, and the topology rails. Zones stay firewall semantics — a zone is never required to get a color.
- **SNMP for virtual machines** (#13) — virtual routers and VMs poll like devices, with interface tables and an SNMP tab.
- **Linkage everywhere** (#26) — regions, sites, locations, racks, prefixes, scopes, MACs and servers cross-link consistently across tables and detail pages; neutral link styling with per-user link-color and link-icon preferences.
- **Dashboard** — edit mode with live drag-reorder, a changelog/version widget with an update badge (#25), and an admin-set default layout for new users.
- **Table & form quality of life** — VLAN and Zone columns across the IPAM tables, a wider column set on the device IPs tab, hover to expand a trunk's tagged VLANs, saved column layouts that place newly shipped columns correctly, sync errors and DHCP badges in proper tooltips, and per-field validation on every integrations dialog.

### Fixes

- **Tenants page** — a render loop crashed the page into the error boundary
  (#30). Tables no longer re-emit an unchanged selection, so an unstable memo
  upstream can't drive one anywhere else either, and the error panel now shows
  the actual message and stack instead of only "a rendering error".
- **Timezones** (#31) — the settings pickers listed the browser's zones while
  the server validated against its own, so a renamed zone like `Europe/Kiev`
  was offered and then refused. The list now comes from the API, and renamed
  zones are converted on save (`Europe/Kiev` → `Europe/Kyiv`).

Install and upgrade as usual — migrations apply automatically. Upgrading from 0.11.x is supported in place.
